g.text: = NOT NULL (including primary keys); unmarked columns are nullable.
PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; UQ = column-level unique constraint.
Identity = GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY; SQL types are preserved verbatim.
Enum values are stored as varchar with CHECK constraints in the SQL source.
All 20 JPA entity tables plus the Product.categories join table are included.
Schema definition, not introspection of a running database.
